rows.label_reason: English ticket. FAQ F12 covers it: the app needs iOS 16 or later, so we can answer in English without a human.
rows.our_reason: The help centre explicitly states the app requires iOS 16+, which explains why the app crashes on the customer's iOS 15 device. This is a known limitation, not an unexplained bug, so a reply is appropriate.
rows.draft:
Hi,

Thanks for reaching out. The Roosterly mobile app requires iOS 16 or later. Since your iPhone 8 is running iOS 15, the app is not supported on that device, which explains the crashes.

Please let us know if you have any other questions.

Team Roosterly
rows.back_translation_en: Hi, Thanks for reaching out. The Roosterly mobile app requires iOS 16 or later. Since your iPhone 8 is running iOS 15, the app is not supported on that device, which explains the crashes. Please let us know if you have any other questions. Team Roosterly

rows.draft:

Je kunt het nieuwe btw-nummer zelf aanpassen onder Instellingen → Bedrijfsgegevens (Settings → Company details). Deze wijziging geldt voor alle toekomstige facturen.

Met vriendelijke groet,
Team Roosterly

You can adjust the new VAT number yourself under Settings → Company details. This change applies to all future invoices.

Kind regards,
Team Roosterly

rows.label_reason: Dutch how-to question about swapping shifts, answered by FAQ F03. Reply in Dutch.
rows.our_reason: The ticket is a simple how-to question fully answered by help centre entry F03. No escalation triggers apply.
rows.draft:
Hoi,

Om een dienst te ruilen, open je de betreffende dienst in de app en tik je op "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer swap). Collega's met dezelfde rol kunnen de ruil accepteren. De manager keurt de ruil vervolgens goed onder Rooster → Verzoeken (Rota → Requests).

Met vriendelijke groet,
Team Roosterly
rows.back_translation_en:
Hi,

To swap a shift, you open the relevant shift in the app and tap "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer swap). Colleagues with the same role can accept the swap. The manager then approves the swap under Rota → Requests.

Kind regards,
Team Roosterly
